en: Black‑and‑white view along a gently rising urban street lined with ornate, multi‑storey historicist apartment blocks or townhouses. The façades are richly decorated with pilasters, pediments, window surrounds and balconies, typical of late 19th‑century Central European architecture. A wrought‑iron fence and bare trees separate the sidewalk from the buildings. Gas‑style street lamps run along the curb. At the far right downhill, a few pedestrians walk, and commercial buildings are visible; one corner building bears a vertical sign. The image has wide white margins and the framing typical of an old photographic postcard.
